title: Giza Pyramids
description: These three shapes are four and a half thousand years old. The pyramids of Giza sit right at the edge of Cairo. How did they build this? Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: Raimond Spekking (CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: These three shapes are four and a half thousand years old.
They are the pyramids of Giza, right at the edge of Cairo.
The biggest, the Great Pyramid, was built from two point three million blocks.
Each side of its base is two hundred thirty meters long.
For over three thousand seven hundred years, nothing humans built was taller.
The pyramid next to it looks bigger, but it just stands on higher ground.
And of the seven ancient wonders, this is the only one still standing.
